tools.name: vf_health
tools.description: Returns VoiceFlip MCP server health and version metadata. No authentication required. Use this first to verify the server is reachable from your MCP client.

tools.name: vf_signup
tools.description: Initiate a VoiceFlip account signup for a business. Returns an agentic signup intent token and the next action: Stripe Shared Payment Token (when Stripe Agentic Commerce is configured), a test-checkout instruction when AGENTIC_ALLOW_TEST_CHECKOUT=1, or a human Stripe Checkout URL. tools.name: vf_complete_signup
tools.description: Complete an agentic signup with a Stripe Shared Payment Token, or with an spt_test_demo token (letters and digits only, for example spt_test_demostage) when AGENTIC_ALLOW_TEST_CHECKOUT=1. tools.name: vf_get_signup_status
tools.description: Poll an agentic signup by intent token. Before payment, returns the current status. After payment (human Checkout or vf_complete_signup), returns the API key, voice agent id, and a working embed snippet (?agentId=). The intent token is the credential. Public, rate-limited per IP.

tools.name: vf_get_pricing
tools.description: Return current VoiceFlip agentic pricing: PAYG per-conversation rates, monthly agentic plan, and wholesale default discount. currency=aed returns fils (730 AED/month starter, matching the /ae market). Other currencies return USD minor units labeled with the requested currency code; Stripe SPT settle

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vf_signup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
